text:
Sam H.: noticing nvme write tail and attach failures in ap-northeast1; GPU attaches stuck. Metrics: write_util climbing fast. Investigating.

engbot: alert: GPU_ATTACH_FAIL spike ap-northeast1 (10m) — alert gpu-attach-8199

Lina M.: paste `iostat -x 1 2` from node gn-ape-211: 
```
nvme0n1   r/s  w/s   rkB/s  wkB/s  r_await  w_await  %util
8.0     190.5  64.0  3800.0    0.18     6.2    92.3
```

Jordan R.: probable janitor/scrub overlap -> writeback storm. Also see intermittent nvme reset in dmesg.

Sam H.: running `./scripts/hot-nvme --region ap-northeast1 --since 15m` -> 18 hosts >80% write_util, 4 hosts with ecc_warn.

Lina M.: immediate mitigations: 1) set `janitor_concurrency=1` for ap-northeast1, 2) throttle scrub_rate=400MB/s for cohort, 3) bump attach_timeout=85s. Applying canary.

deploybot: rollout-started: config attach_timeout=85s canary 10% (id db2a)

Jordan R.: agree. Add alert if write_util stays >85% for 20m. We'll schedule firmware cohort review later.

Sam H.: created incident ticket with logs and commands. Monitoring — will update when janitor cap takes effect. :thumbsup:
